summary: Steep kerb beside bush on a through road, with no parking.
reasons: No verge, bush bank at kerb

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the east side and a motorway beyond; houses 14 m and 22 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight into dense bush with no pull-off; the lane is the only flat ground.
drivers.traffic: Through road curving to a motorway; no parked cars seen in either image.
drivers.convention: No parking convention; no cars along the kerb.

flags: Low-lying: Witton Creek 81 m away, though elevation is 36 to 40 m
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy covers the east side, shading mornings.
